scenarios.name: one review per member per vendor and one upvote per member per review

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_vendors__vendors (id, name, category, added_by, created_at, updated_at, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'everyone')
INSERT INTO app_vendors__reviews (id, vendor_id, member_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 5, 'great', ?, ?, 'everyone')
INSERT INTO app_vendors__reviews (id, vendor_id, member_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, 'changed my mind', ?, ?, 'everyone')

scenarios.name: in a shared space a participant adult cannot edit or remove another member's vendor, review or upvote, while the steward can

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_vendors__vendors (id, name, category, notes, added_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('v-b', 'Ace Plumbing', 'plumbing', '', ?, '2026-09-01T09:00:00Z', '2026-09-01T09:00:00Z')

SELECT id FROM app_vendors__vendors
